questions.question: When was the ibuprofen allergy first recorded?
Has the patient been prescribed or dispensed ibuprofen since reporting this reaction?
What other NSAIDs or analgesics have been used, and were there similar reactions?
Was any diagnostic testing (e.g., spirometry, challenge test) done to confirm ibuprofen-induced bronchospasm?
Has a formal allergy alert or documentation been added to the record beyond this patient note?
Were alternative analgesics or management strategies recommended after this report?
